_comment_purpose: Org-managed settings that ENFORCE the inverita-guardrail PHI check on the Claude Code CLI. Enforcement is done by defining the guard HOOK directly in managed settings (not by force-installing a plugin — see _comment_why_hook_not_plugin). Managed settings have the HIGHEST precedence in Claude Code and cannot be overridden by user (~/.claude) or project (.claude) settings. Keys prefixed with _comment_ are documentation only — delete them before deploying (they are ignored, but keep the file tidy).
_comment_why_hook_not_plugin: IMPORTANT: There is no supported managed-settings key that force-INSTALLS a named plugin onto the Claude Code CLI. The claude.ai admin console plugin preferences ('Required' / auto-install) target Cowork and claude.ai web/mobile; for the CLI an org plugin is merely made available and the developer still installs it. So DO NOT rely on 'enabledPlugins' for enforcement. Instead we deliver the guard as a MANAGED HOOK: managed settings register the UserPromptSubmit hook themselves, pointing at the guard script deployed to a fixed root-owned path. This is the mechanism the CLI actually enforces.
_comment_deploy_script: STEP 1 — Deploy the guard code. Push the ENTIRE plugin directory (this repo) to a fixed, root-owned path via your MDM (Jamf, Intune, Ansible, ...). Keep the repo's internal layout so 'hooks/' and a WRITABLE 'logs/' subdir both exist. Recommended paths: Linux /opt/inverita-guardrail, macOS /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/inverita-guardrail, Windows C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\inverita-guardrail. The script itself should be read-only to developers; the logs/ subdir must be writable (e.g. mode 1777) or the metadata-only audit log is silently skipped (audit logging fails open by design and never blocks the guard).
_comment_hooks: STEP 2 — Register the guard as a managed UserPromptSubmit hook. The command path below must match STEP 1's deploy path. No matcher = fires on every prompt. Because this hook lives in MANAGED settings, it runs regardless of the developer's own user/project settings.
_comment_allowManagedHooksOnly: REQUIRED for real enforcement. When true, Claude Code executes ONLY hooks that originate from managed settings / managed plugins and ignores hooks defined in user or project settings. Without this a developer could register a competing UserPromptSubmit hook or otherwise interfere; with it, the guard above is the authoritative prompt hook. This is the line between 'recommended' and 'enforced'.
_comment_strictPluginOnlyCustomization: OPTIONAL — TOTAL LOCKDOWN, OFF BY DEFAULT. When true, skills, agents, hooks, AND MCP servers may ONLY come from plugins or managed settings — never from user or project sources. WARNING: this DISABLES every developer's own user/project-scoped MCP servers, skills, and agents, not just competing hooks. It is NOT required to enforce this guard (allowManagedHooksOnly above already makes the guard the authoritative UserPromptSubmit hook). Enable it ONLY if your org intends full customization lockdown and has accepted that developers lose their own MCP. To turn it on, add "strictPluginOnlyCustomization": true as a real key below.
_comment_delivery_paths: Deliver THIS file (with _comment_ keys removed) to the OS-level managed-settings path via your MDM. These paths are root/administrator-owned and NOT user-writable, so a developer-level session cannot edit or delete them to bypass the guard. Do NOT place managed settings in ~/.claude/ — that path is user-writable and therefore bypassable.
_comment_delivery_server_managed: ALTERNATIVE delivery — Team/Enterprise admin console (server-managed settings). Configure these managed settings in the claude.ai admin console and assign them to the PixelCare Health workspace/users. They reach devices at auth time and refresh ~hourly, so a developer who edits local settings has the managed policy re-applied on the next refresh. Requires a Claude for Teams or Enterprise plan. The file/MDM path above is stronger for hard enforcement because it is root-owned and offline.
_comment_verify: After deploying, have a developer run /status in Claude Code. The 'Setting sources' line should show 'Enterprise managed settings' with the source in parentheses — e.g. (file) for the MDM-pushed managed-settings.json, or (remote) for admin-console delivery. That confirms the managed hook is active.
_comment_marketplace_is_optout: The plugin marketplace (.claude-plugin/marketplace.json) is the OPT-IN distribution channel for developers who install the guard voluntarily, and the path for Cowork/claude.ai. It is NOT the enforcement mechanism. Enforcement for the CLI is the managed hook above.
_comment_scope: This filters what is typed into Claude Code prompts. It is a client-side control and NOT a substitute for BAA/HIPAA-compliant upstream data handling. Real PHI must never be entered into any prompt regardless of this guard.
